function: above_phy: learning decides UAV placement (dueling DDQN, p. 10) and user selection (ANN, p. 7); bandwidth allocation is convex optimization (p. 9); FL aggregates digitally over OFDMA (p. 5).
notes: Excluded as above_phy (Step 1, check 4). p. 10: "we utilize the DRL method to deploy the UAV to optimize the energy consumption in the FL process"; UAV placement is above the physical layer. p. 7: an ANN predicts the gradient change that sets user-selection probabilities (scheduling). p. 9: bandwidth allocation, the only physical-layer decision, is convex optimization solved with CVX. p. 5: FL aggregates digitally with OFDMA, not over the air, and p. 13 says the radio map model is used solely to verify the method, so it is not area 7. no_learning not used because the method contains learned components.
